annotations.title: Look up a work by ISRC

description: Use when the user asks: 'lookup ISRC X', 'what's the work for ISRC X?', 'find the work for this recording'. Shortcut: look up the work(s) associated with a recording identifier (ISRC). Equivalent to directory_list_works with an isrc filter, pinned for recording-first discovery. → then: directory_lookup_work (full details on the matched work)
name: directory_lookup_isrc
title: Look up a work by ISRC
